PGM_REFERENCE.note: internal memory policy of the accepted engine recorded, not rewritten; the outer 3 GiB contract is shared

PGM_EXPERIMENTAL_REF.note: the 3283cfd result records its single policy under the key `policy`; it has no policy_version / risk_allocations fields

gates.validity: every recorded cell has one terminal receipt, identity_ok, a valid output (inventory, geometry, labels, witness, simplex, binding) and a valid arm contract (policy / version / configuration / allowed backends / risk shares / epsilon / delta / deadline / terminal attempts); zero published-geometry faults; no deterministic interval conflict across arms or repeats
gates.completeness: all 732 declared cells recorded within the ceiling; otherwise INCOMPLETE
gates.historical_accepted_preservation: PGM_ACCEPTED both-repeat completions include every task of the 29 both-repeat completions of previous_accepted_cells.json (lost == [])
gates.same_round_accepted_preservation: PGM_ACCEPTED both-repeat completions include every PGM_REFERENCE both-repeat completion; a PGM_REFERENCE task that misses a historical success is a reference-reproduction failure, recorded separately, never attributed to the new wrapper
gates.historical_experimental_preservation: PGM_EXPERIMENTAL both-repeat completions include every task of the 3283cfd both-repeat completion set (47 tasks) -- requires the hashed extract of the 122 scored 3283cfd PGM cells (prior_experimental_extract below); NOT EVALUABLE when that extract is absent
gates.same_round_experimental_preservation: PGM_EXPERIMENTAL both-repeat completions include every PGM_EXPERIMENTAL_REF both-repeat completion (same host, same round)
gates.paired_overhead: see cost_criterion; flags hold default promotion pending explanation, they do not fail validity
gates.promotion: accepted becomes the shipped default on main only with validity PASS, completeness PASS, historical_accepted_preservation PASS, same_round_accepted_preservation PASS and no unexplained cost flag; no re-tuning to meet any gate

cost_criterion.rule: a task is FLAGGED when PGM_ACCEPTED is slower than PGM_REFERENCE in BOTH repeats by more than 1.25x AND more than 0.1 s (paired, same-round mutual completions)
cost_criterion.effect: a flag holds default promotion pending a recorded explanation; all paired wall ratios and differences are reported
cost_criterion.origin: proposed by the step-1 benchmark review; adopted prospectively in STEP2_AMENDMENT_1 before any scored cell

prior_experimental_extract.prerequisite: the scored 3283cfd campaign's raw CELLS.jsonl / ANALYSIS.json (EXPOSURE_HISTORY.json records analysis_sha256 45d954bb3c4d68e8804a42041bd90c6f79a668dccb61f2692b7bfb8b6fe52d6f) from the consolidation-v1 run directory, which was never committed and is not present in this checkout, the records repository or the review packet
prior_experimental_extract.consequence: the historical experimental preservation gate is NOT EVALUABLE in this run; the same-round pinned PGM_EXPERIMENTAL_REF arm (3283cfd executed here) supplies the executable experimental comparator instead; no target rows are invented from task names or summary counts

notes: All 61 inputs are exposed regression inputs; old55 / former_eval6 are historical groups only.
One frozen implementation per arm; no per-task tuning or hindsight selection.
Same 20 s outer contract; pgm allowance 19.5 s; process-tree RSS sampled 10 ms, grace 0.
Compilation happened in setup only; the artifacts actually loaded are hashed above.
The scored ceiling is the declared maximum charge of the full matrix; exhaustion returns INCOMPLETE.
